email.subject: Keel Pros Auto Care: two quick fixes
email.body:
Jack,

Looked at the Keel Pros Auto Care site. Two things likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call number, so mobile visitors searching for auto care in Harbor Falls can't tap to call you directly. And your hours aren't listed anywhere on the site, so people can't tell if you're open before driving over or calling.

Both are quick fixes. Happy to walk you through exactly what I'd change in a free 10-minute call, no obligation.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
